scope: Decisive local-capacity diagnostic on the served ordinary-prose path: a float linear probe of the model's own served state against the artifact's own ternary readout and the tuned two-token count reference, on the same development targets, plus a shuffled-target null probe as the instrument control. Local Rust implementation, one release build, diagnostic runs on two sealed artifacts, evidence, documentation and protected delivery. No new model fit unless the diagnosis points at the readout, in which case one bounded matched arm is included below. No paid or external compute.

extension_reason: The live balance of 1,484,360 ms cannot cover the decisive local-capacity diagnostic and its delivery.
